lines.zh: 爪子踩得地面发颤，我故意走给你听。
lines.en: My claws make the ground tremble. I walk loudly on purpose.

lines.zh: 长尾一扫，草丛全给我让路。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail and the grass clears a path.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，别想跑。
lines.en: One of my steps is three of yours. Don't bother running.

lines.zh: 混合的基因在催我快走。
lines.en: My mixed genes keep telling me to move faster.
The sail on my back rides the wind as I stride.

lines.zh: 脚跟先落地，猎手都这样走。
lines.en: Heel first. That is how a hunter walks.

lines.zh: 我沿着血迹慢慢踱过来。
lines.en: I stroll along the trail of blood.

lines.zh: 四步一停，我在挑谁最弱。
lines.en: Four steps, then a pause. Picking the weakest one.

lines.zh: 这条腿来自掠食者，天生不肯慢。
lines.en: These legs came from a predator. They refuse to slow.
The circle keeps tightening.

lines.zh: 脚下泥土被我一爪掀起。
lines.en: Each claw drags up a clod of soil.

lines.zh: 走得很稳，像这里归我管。
lines.en: Steady gait. This ground is mine.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我走路不看人。
lines.en: Keep back. I don't watch where I walk.

lines.zh: 影子里多了两条腿，那是我。
lines.en: There's an extra pair of legs in your shadow. That's me.
Licking my teeth, thinking of my last meal.
Human scent on the wind. I take my time with it.

lines.zh: 站着不动，让你先怕一会儿。
lines.en: Standing still, letting you be afraid first.
My tail taps the ground, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 我这混合的基因，很管用。
lines.en: My mixed genes serve me well.
The sail on my back swells and settles.
Counting the distance. How many strides?
A shadow moved. I thought it was food.
So quiet here. Almost like a grave.
My talons scrape against the stone.

lines.zh: 两个物种的脑子在吵架。
lines.en: Two species argue inside my head. Both want meat.
You're watching me too? Then keep still.
Waiting for the light to fade before I act.
Footsteps somewhere. Very far.
You're standing very still. Like food.
That's your height? That's your height?

lines.zh: 我眼里只有会跑的东西。
lines.en: My eyes only find things that run.
Come closer. Let me scent you properly.
Don't smile. I know what your bones look like.

lines.zh: 你把武器举起来，手在抖。
lines.en: You raised a weapon. Your hands shake.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你哪里最软。
lines.en: I tilt my head, sizing up your softest spot.
I see fear in your eyes. Good.

lines.zh: 混血的眼睛，看得比你想的多。
lines.en: These hybrid eyes see more than you think.

lines.zh: 你在数我的牙？数不清的。
lines.en: Counting my teeth? You'll lose count.

lines.zh: 抬头，别低头，让我看着你。
lines.en: Chin up. Let me see your face.
I've followed your scent a long way.
You hit me? Then I hit back.
This hybrid body doesn't back down.
A bone cracked. I can still run.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片不是你砍的木头。
lines.en: My hide isn't firewood.
Fine. Now we're even.
Gritting my teeth. Don't think that's fear.
Heavy hands. Credit where due.
Blood runs warm. I like this more.
Try that again.
This gash will scar.
Meat. Raw meat.
That piece in your hand. Toss it.
I'll take two steps closer for that.
The smell of blood makes my teeth itch.
Meat down, you back up. Understand?
Both of my bloodlines are drooling.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我会咬到手。
lines.en: Stop waving it. I'll take the hand too.

lines.zh: 我吃得很快，你最好让开。
lines.en: I eat fast. Better step aside.
One piece isn't enough. I have a big appetite.
Nothing rotten. I want it fresh.
Bumped me? I'm harder than a wall.
Step back off my toes.

lines.zh: 这么近，是你自己送上门的。
lines.en: This close? You delivered yourself.
One turn of my shoulder and you're down.
Don't crowd me. My claws don't check names.
I'm not a rock. Move.
You bumped me. Is that a declaration?

lines.zh: 身上的棘刺扎到你了吧。
lines.en: My spines grazed you, didn't they.
I stepped back half a pace. That's a courtesy.

lines.zh: 碰撞声像两根骨头敲在一起。
lines.en: That sound is two bones knocking.
Same kind? Your scent is off.
Being a hybrid makes courtship hard.
Let's answer each other, just once.
Slowly. Circle for me first.

lines.zh: 我尾巴摇得不好看，但真诚。
lines.en: My tail display is ugly, but honest.
Both bloodlines agree: her.
We'll nest out of the wind.
You guard the eggs. I'll hunt.

lines.zh: 我蹭一下你的脖子，别躲。
lines.en: I'll nudge your neck. Don't flinch.

lines.zh: 生下来的小家伙会很凶。
lines.en: Our hatchlings will be vicious.
A bone. I can crack it.
Meat on the ground. Mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，不是给你看的。
lines.en: Picking this up. Not for your viewing.
This smells like old prey.
Drop something and I'm on it.
It's dusty. Still fine.

lines.zh: 我叼着这个走路更开心。
lines.en: Carrying this makes the walk nicer.
My teeth are faster than your hands.
Not a keepsake. Rations.
Gripped tight. Don't grab.
You moved. So you're not a rock.
Locked on. Don't look back.
That scent. Right there.
Decided. You're today's meal.
I can hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你迈出那一步，就已经输了。
lines.en: That step sealed it.
Both bloodlines just woke up.
I saw you slip behind that tree.
Small target. Enough to eat.
Don't run. Running just makes it last longer.
The spines on my neck just rose.

lines.zh: 我的头骨低下去，对准你。
lines.en: My skull lowers and lines up on you.

lines.zh: 你身上铁味很重，我不怕。
lines.en: You reek of iron. I'm not impressed.
From now on, just you and me.
My long tail levels out like a rudder.
Several kinds of genes run in me.
Don't count on me tiring.
I don't blink. Do you?
You're looking for an exit. So am I.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，你转不过来。
lines.en: I take your flank. You can't turn fast enough.

lines.zh: 爪子在地上刮出四道印。
lines.en: Four grooves scraped into the dirt.
Just waiting for you to turn.
The smell of blood grows nearer.
Each pace I take, the ground answers.
Climbing high won't dodge my teeth.
You're panting. I hear it.

lines.zh: 这一片没有第二个出口。
lines.en: There is no second way out of here.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，一直没有走。
lines.en: I keep watching. I never left.
Three strides left.
This claw tears your armor open.

lines.zh: 混起来的基因，咬合力更大。
lines.en: Mixed genes, and a harder bite.

lines.zh: 爪子从上面下来，躲不掉。
lines.en: The claws come from above. No dodging.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先落到你肩上。
lines.en: My claws land on your shoulder first.

lines.zh: 牙齿撞上骨头，声音不错。
lines.en: Teeth on bone. Nice sound.

lines.zh: 我张口，牙齿扣住你的腿。
lines.en: I open wide and clamp my teeth on your leg.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴也是一件武器。
lines.en: The tail is a weapon too.
One foot comes down. Stay still.
Blood on my face. I won't wipe it off.
You blocked the claw. Not the teeth.
I slam in like a living wall.

lines.zh: 这一下是替上一个猎物。
lines.en: That one was for the last prey.
Still standing? Again.

lines.zh: 咬开那层皮，比想的容易。
lines.en: That hide split easier than I thought.

lines.zh: 从培养槽里，我被拼出来了。
lines.en: Pieced together, out of a vat.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，这世界太绿了。
lines.en: I open my eyes. Too much green.

lines.zh: 谁的基因把我弄成这样？
lines.en: Whose genes made me like this?
First thing on landing: find food.
I'm here. My smell got here first.

lines.zh: 这片林子刚多了个顶级猎手。
lines.en: This forest just gained a top hunter.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根枯枝，算打招呼。
lines.en: Snapped a dead branch. Consider it a greeting.

lines.zh: 混血的东西，生来就该活。
lines.en: A hybrid is born to survive.

lines.zh: 混了两种基因，我谁都不像。
lines.en: Two bloodlines, and I match neither.

lines.zh: 实验品也好，猎手也好，我饿了。
lines.en: Experiment or hunter, I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 你的狗刚才叫了，它知道。
lines.en: Your dog just barked. It knows.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着两副牙的脾气。
lines.en: Born with the temper of two sets of jaws.

lines.zh: 石头缝里挤出我这么个东西。
lines.en: Something like me squeezed out of the rocks.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁，有汗，有晚饭。
lines.en: Iron, sweat, dinner. All in the air.
Don't ask who I am. Run.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，鸟全飞了。
lines.en: Every bird took off when I landed.

lines.zh: 第十三次实验，终于站起来了。
lines.en: Thirteenth attempt. I finally stood up.
I'm here. This territory is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过来，棘帆在冒烟。
lines.en: Flames licked up. My sail is smoking.

lines.zh: 从高处砸下来，腿骨发麻。
lines.en: Dropped from height. My leg bones are ringing.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻孔，我不擅长游泳。
lines.en: Water up my snout. I'm no swimmer.

lines.zh: 爆风把碎石塞进我伤口。
lines.en: The blast packed gravel into my wound.
An arrow hangs in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 骨头里发冷，这不是牙咬的。
lines.en: Cold inside my bones. No teeth did that.

lines.zh: 饿了三天，连虫子都塞牙。
lines.en: Three days empty. Even bugs would do.

lines.zh: 天打雷，我的鳞片全亮了。
lines.en: The sky struck. Every scale lit up.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我还在掉。
lines.en: Nothing below me. Still falling.
